name: spreadsheet
description: Read CSV/JSON files, query rows, compute basic statistics.

path.description: Path to CSV or JSON file

manual.overview: Use when you need to read CSV/JSON files, filter rows, or compute basic stats. Ideal for tabular data stored locally.

examples.description: Read first 10 rows from a CSV file
Filter rows where region equals West

tips: Use action=read for quick inspection, action=query for filtered data, action=stats for summaries
Set limit to avoid loading huge datasets into memory
Column names are case-sensitive; ensure filter_column matches file headers
Prefer CSV for tabular data; JSON for nested structures
edge_cases: Large files may be slow; use limit and filter to reduce scope
Malformed CSV (unescaped commas, missing headers) can cause parse errors
Encoding issues with non-ASCII characters; check file encoding
